description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for database operations related to JobCategory entities including retrieval, saving, and deletion of job categories.

classes.name: JobCategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for JobCategory, providing methods to retrieve, save, and delete job category records in the database.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobCategory entities, supports sorting, pagination, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobCategory entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs for existing JobCategory entities matching the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Persists a JobCategory entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes JobCategory entities with specified IDs from the database.
